oneOp: One op per call, as the only key: {"<op>": {...}}.
game_check: Facts on this game's running build. {oneOp} No op: look. look: the page as a player opens it, then a moment of play: errors with file:line, frame rate, both frames (play beside the reference picture). final: the full check before you end a turn: also the player's entry, the scene report and the QA play, whose problems are bugs to fix. facts: what the harness measured on a build. status: toolchain, preview URL, model choice and art providers.
game_play: Drive the running game. {oneOp} preview: the playable URL. start, act, close: a session of input batches, each answered with a frame, text, controls, errors. bot: a real-time run of a .studio/bot/ file, with video and findings; bot_view: a past one. replay: test plays every build replays; save names the last ended run, or run; run, at: a run (id or name) at a second as an image. model_sheet: named models from six sides, with size and cost.
game_assets: Art, sound and the look. {oneOp} search: the open library, as a contact sheet; add: files, credited. lock: STYLE.json for made things. generate: starts paid art with the person's providers, answering an id (start each once); wait: its files or the pick it awaits. image_edit: a game image edited by words, for the person's pick. pictures: HTML or SVG per data row, as sheets. mine: the person's Library. A refusal says what is missing: tell the person.
game_blender: This game's managed Blender: a live scene, saved as the game's .blend after each change. {oneOp} code: runs bpy Python. look: the scene as an image; mode review shows what export writes. scene: objects as text. export: the reviewed objects as a GLB with its sidecar. character: a rigged humanoid on the standard skeleton, sized. paint: textures from a turnaround sheet. sprites: framed 2D strips. animate: keys a move from poses on beats. asset_search, asset_import: Poly Haven, Sketchfab, Poly Pizza, library or generated assets into the scene. addon: installs a listed add-on once the person agrees. How: studio-skills/art-pipeline.md.
game_builds: Builds and undo. {oneOp} No op: list. list: builds, newest first, with facts. compare: two builds' facts. undo: takes a build out, later ones kept; restore: goes back to a build; both only when the person asks. copies: work not in the game yet. bring_in: your copy, or a child's (chat), into the game. update: the game's newer builds into your copy. saved: videos and images. export: a release. package: a ZIP. stop: stops this game's processes.
game_keep_going: Keep going, only when the person asks. No input: what it is doing. mode: off, guided or autopilot; budgetMinutes (null for none) on start or resume; steer: the person's words for its next step. A message starting "Keep going · step N" is a step: do that one change.
